name: FabCon Europe 2026: AI, security and governance
summary: This site reports on applied AI, security and governance in Microsoft Fabric, from FabCon Europe 2026.
Two of us attended: one with a focus on applied AI, and a data engineer.
Each statement has an evidence label: Slide, Notes, Microsoft, Third party, Research, Attendee account or Our reading.
Speaker statements are not tested facts, and nothing here was tested in our own tenant.

groups.title: Limits
groups.gloss: What the agent can reach and do

threadMapText: An agent needs three things: context (what it knows), limits (what it can reach and do) and proof (what it leaves behind). A reality check on cost and dependency applies to all three.

pages.title: FabCon Europe 2026: AI, security and governance
pages.message: Fabric gives agents context. Control and proof are a work in progress.
